title: Conditional κ = 0.003663028410 (+>6.256184e-7 over #7623, common U)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

**Conditional κ ≥ 0.003663028410**, a gain **>6.256184e-7 over #7623’s complete published upper 0.0036624027916**, within an explicit common finite-tariff whole-private-extent supplier model **U**. One fixed ten-record composition ports the published #7608 stay drop and #7613 902/1091 contact rechart onto #7623. Complete signed paid jobs fall **110,145→110,111**, with 22,461 productive jobs and surplus 1,424 unchanged; no extra paid MOVE. Native ΔP is `{1:-3,2:+1,4:-1,5:+1}`, multiplied by 17 for the signed invoice; ΔT=0.

**Changed hypothesis:** the same stronger, unimplemented U applies to BOTH 180-lifetime words, every admitted width/column multiplicity, complete private coded extents, old junk/blanks and reachable rounded residuals, atomic return, nonaliasing, spectators and outputs. The existing combined lifetime item of **4,000 ordinary source units per lifetime pair covers its entire assigned work, including non-reset work**; it is not spare reset funding. INIT and CLEAR each receive 32 scalar-service units and the retained normalized 2^20 coefficient with all original size and precision factors. No extra uncounted storage, descriptor, tape or recursive child is permitted. Fresh shared signed precision is 2430≤4096; the common input domain is h≥max(H_source,H_candidate), as specified in the README.

**U is not implemented; no implication from #7623’s original erasure premise, same-original-premise dominance, unconditional multiplication theorem, human/formal acceptance or selected-frontier adoption is established.** The five inherited framework assumptions remain. One erased row changes: owner1557/lifetime1/chart595, source43314→candidate43308, `-e451-3/2e902-3/2e985+e1495` becomes `-e451+e1495`. Twelve owned scalar interfaces change. All 180 source and candidate erasure relations are freshly checked; these relations do not implement physical erasure.

## Task and overlap

[Scoped claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/7111#discussioncomment-19643203).

This is a new word and full qualification on the 180-lifetime source, not renewed credit for completed #7622. Source #7623’s loan engine was inspected but **not run**. Its original fixed-candidate old-observation equality checker is not relabelled as acceptance of changed private interfaces. The source #7620→#7621→#7623 edit chain is reconstructed and authenticated. Existing source packages, shared code and selected records are unchanged.

A later publication refresh found **#7624 at 3f231831e0bff0cc5241ec89e122d99132bddf52**, reporting the larger 204-CLEAR candidate κ .003665051802188 with six changed exact-Q forms and unresolved extra erasure applicability. It reports our 902/1091 contact absent and overlapping stay/loan mechanisms. Its word and assumptions are **not incorporated or qualified here**. This submission preserves its already-completed 180-lifetime experiment and adds a fully qualified common-U gain over #7623; it does not claim the largest open numeric result, exclusive device novelty or dominance over #7624.

## Validation

One fresh serial Linux/Python3.12 application with one CPU, 2 GiB hard memory and zero swap; no scientific retry:

- Paired exact replay on all 1,569 formal entrance symbols, complete incident closure, independent forward/reverse covector and rank-one perturbation, actual reduced-row grid, COPY guards, all 180 lifecycle identities and owned observations. Fresh c=e902+e985; all final perturbation coefficients vanish. Source-free positive/rejecting controls ran before construction. Four replacements and six deletions give **77,277→77,271 events**.
- **964** source/candidate affected transport pairs, each **512 forward+512 adjoint columns**, canonical phase/rank and rejecting controls. The direct candidate-versus-#7481 set has963; the full independently frozen union retains964. Complete finite physical replay: **77,271 events, 3,017 chart pairs, 104 ports**.
- Both 180-relation certificate sets freshly constructed and separately checked by the standalone verifier with coefficient and wrong-cleared-field controls.
- Fresh complete signed application: **3,099 catalogue cases**, contiguous coverage, assembly, **104 boundary bindings**, **58 outer predicates**, actual17-call invoice, compiler/physical/grid/precision/tape checks, three stale native outputs and four stale receipt-binding mutations rejected.
- Fresh paired source-resource branch runs seven checks using the current native calculations and actual signed invoice/gate. **The source catalogue was not rerun, and this derived branch is not a standalone source-native pass.** Nineteen transient source-branch files and running cgroup custody are preserved as author observations, not independent attestation.
- Matched ingredient ordinary **864,265,120→864,227,608**; signed ordinary **789,817,792→789,782,364**. Signed precision2430 for both; scalar services **44,278,976→44,276,800**; elementary records **25,413,787,840→25,407,989,888**. All lifetime and original nonzero tariff charges remain included.
- Independent directed integer-power and log/exp prices support the conservative claim and strict probe **.003663028410007**. The supplied monotonic fixed-invoice crossing bracket and headroom bound this profile; they are not a universal mechanism ceiling.

First gate: **80.54s**, observed peak173,604,864bytes. Full qualification: **1,887.74s** controller, **1,881.59 CPU s**, kernel peak **1,228,132,352bytes**, all6 stages pass and empty process group afterward; native1284.51s, signed497.22s. Full freeze **9ddf5e1e163ae02f08b7107068f92091f5274474b54b4e85f07622b12fe19e42**.

Artifact integrity passes normal/optimized Python, a fresh read-only copy, missing/empty inventories, missing nested manifest, altered source/map and semantic zero/missing/duplicate pair controls. Metadata-only offline materialization passes; no second scientific run is inferred. Repository metadata/pins and exact committed-byte/declared-base-history checks pass. **Registered VERIFY runs integrity only; hosted scientific replay is not claimed.**

From the package directory:

```sh
python3 -I -B INTEGRITY.py
python3 -I -B reproduce.py --work /tmp/new-offline-tree
# Explicit fresh full qualification, Linux user systemd required:
python3 -I -B reproduce.py --work /tmp/new-qualified-tree --run
```

The explicit replay retains the committed candidate and first-gate evidence; it does not cold-rerun the first gate. Pending-PR Git ancestry is distinct from the bundled byte authentication. Hosted checks will be reported against the actual submitted head; the inherited main CI-navigation defect is not repaired by this package.
